product_metadata.title: DII Basic Terry Collection Waffle Dishtowel Set, 15x26, Solid Stonewash Blue, 4 Piece
features: DISH TOWELS TO TACKLE ANY JOB: Set of 4 cotton dishtowels measures 15x26" each to tackle all of your drying, wiping, and cleaning tasks

QUALITY MATERIAL THAT'S EASY TO CARE FOR: Wash with cold water on gentle cycle, tumble dry low; We recommend washing before first use, towels will lose excess lint and will become softer and more absorbent with each washing; Do not bleach; We recommend not using fabric softener or a hot drying cycle
LIGHTWEIGHT AND QUICK DRYING: These towels are lightweight and absorbent; The durable, low lint material dries quickly
EASILY COORDINATE WITH YOUR KITCHEN: These dishtowels are available in a variety of colors to match your kitchen, no matter your décor or color scheme

MORE DII KITCHEN OPTIONS: DII offers delightful linens and decor including dishtowels, aprons, potholders, storage, throws, and more; Click the DII link at the top of the page to explore our other collections
description: DII solid waffle dishtowel sets are our customers’ all-time favorite basic towel for everyday kitchen needs. DII offers these dish towel sets at an affordable price with unmatched quality. The cotton is woven with a tight knit, allowing for less lint on your glasses or plates. These dishtowels are made of 100% cotton with a classic waffle design in a variety of colors to coordinate with any kitchen décor. With each wash, these towels become more absorbent, helping to clean up even the biggest messes. Towels air dry quickly and are ready to use again in no time.

details.Product Care Instructions: Machine Wash colors separately cold water. Do not bleach. Tumble Dry Low. Wash Before First Use
